description: The Wharton blocks of the Jerome Fisher Program in Management & Technology (M&T). Path@Penn's public audits are run against a plain Wharton student, so they carry the conditions that switch an M&T student onto these blocks but not the blocks themselves. These were read from Path@Penn what-if audits for programs WU_BS_MANT and WU_BS_MAT_U, which were identical across the 2024, 2025 and 2026 catalogs. Only requirement structure is kept.

sources.audit: Path@Penn what-if audits, programs WU_BS_MANT (FNCS, MGMT-SMGT) and WU_BS_MAT_U, catalogs 202430, 202530 and 202630
sources.recovered: Path drops the alternatives of a requirement the audited student has already met. Those were recovered from the public plain-Wharton audits, where the same rule appears without the MANT suffix, and the Wharton probability options from the Penn catalog's Coordinated Dual Degree Programs page.

blocks.title: Quantitative/Computational Skills
blocks.note: Replaces First-Year Foundations (U-WFYF) for M&T students. Path does not expose this block's code, so U-WQCS is our own.
